S430.desc: Ashimita steps in front of the party and cuts. His grandfather screams the whole time. (Katana, one enemy)
S430.name: Shiba Ashimita: Yojimbo's Cut

S439.desc: Benjiro paints the death-mask on every face. Nobody fears, nobody is charmed, for a round. (Party: immune to Terror and charm)
S439.name: Moto Benjiro: Death Trance

S634.desc: Benjiro paints the death-mask on every face - and leaves his own bare. Nobody fears, nobody is charmed, for a round. (Party: immune to Terror and charm; 3 uses)
S634.name: Moto Benjiro: Death Trance

S445.desc: Pain is a rumour. Ignore it. (ATK up)
S445.name: Fury Without End

S446.desc: A long perfect blade, drawn once.
S446.name: Seppun Iaijutsu

S447.desc: Arrows from above, all at once. (all; ATK down)
S447.name: Volley from the Rocks

S449.desc: Both armies cower. "Run. Everyone runs from Sorrow's Path eventually." (all; Terror)
S449.name: Terror Aura

S460.desc: The dragon tattoo breathes fire across the enemy line. It burns Yosai too. (Fire, all enemies; costs 10% of his HP)
S460.name: Dragon's Breath

S461.desc: The arrowroot tattoo draws an ally's wounds into Yosai's own skin. (Heal one ally, more as he levels, but never more than half their HP; costs 15% of his HP)
S461.name: Arrowroot

S462.desc: "My blood - for power - gladly - less gladly." Maho paid in his own blood. (Taint chance; costs him 3% of his HP)
S462.name: Blood Bolt (maho)

S463.desc: A cultist hurls himself forward, chanting.
S463.name: Painted Frenzy

S476.desc: Gendo questions a human foe mid-fight: reveals its weaknesses, and it fears being seen through (ATK down). A hypnotised foe stops fighting.
S476.name: Interrogate

S478.desc: Momo remembers every detail of the foe, the way she remembers plums. Its weaknesses are revealed. (one enemy)
S478.name: Kitsuki Momo: Perfect Recall

S481.desc: Mirumoto school, Rank 1: two blades, two truths. One hand states, the other checks. (Katana, 2 hits; answers an iaijutsu draw)
S481.name: Daisho Technique

S482.desc: A Bo strike to the wrist: meant to disarm, not to kill. (Bo, light; it ends a fight with a man who wants to die)
S482.name: Subdue

S483.desc: A deep, correct bow. A kappa must bow back, and spills the water from its head-dish (Suki). Nothing else is impressed.
S483.name: Bow

S484.desc: Seppun iaijutsu, perfect, drawn once at the nearest man.
S484.name: Ushimo's Draw

S485.desc: The cut the Seppun teach to men who stand in front of Emperors.
S485.name: Seppun Guard's Cut

S486.desc: The kappa grabs an ankle and pulls for the water. (Grapple: Speed down)
S486.name: Drag Under

S489.desc: Ushimo's iaijutsu, drawn now for someone else's sake. (Katana, one enemy)
S489.name: Seppun Draw

S490.desc: The Wasp tattoo: two blows where there should be one.
S490.name: Wasp Sting

S491.desc: A crack, a cloud of white smoke, and lead.
S491.name: Volley

S492.desc: The pikes come down in a hedge. (DEF up, all allies)
S492.name: Pike Wall

S493.desc: A foreign sword, heavy and straight, swung like an axe.
S493.name: Broadsword Cleave

S496.desc: A brush-stroke that leaves the silk and keeps going. (Water)
S496.name: Living Ink

S506.desc: Yoritomo courtiers learn to stand in a storm. Rui throws one. (Air, one enemy)
S506.name: Storm Heart

S507.desc: Two hooked cuts, low and high. (Tanto x2, one enemy)
S507.name: Kama Flurry

S508.desc: The leech latches on and drinks. (Taint chance)
S508.name: Drain

S509.desc: Yellow fog from the oni's mouth. Breathe it and you forget who you are. (Terror chance)
S509.name: Spirit Leeching

S510.desc: Maho: the air in your throat turns to wool. (Air; Silence chance)
S510.name: Choking Death

S511.desc: Maho: something in the box drinks. (Taint chance)
S511.name: Drain Soul

S523.desc: A blade of fire bursts from the shugenja's hand, roaring like a forge. (Fire)
S523.name: Katana of Fire

S524.desc: Sea water fills your lungs from nowhere. (Water; Slowed)
S524.name: Suitengu's Embrace

S525.desc: An amulet twisted, and the squad grows strong. (ATK up, all allies)
S525.name: Sharing the Strength of Many

S526.desc: Rin steps in front of an ally: every enemy blow comes to her for two turns.
S526.name: Cover

S527.desc: An Akodo war-shout: ATK up, and the whole party acts first next turn.
S527.name: The Clouds Part

S530.desc: The elemental flares white-hot across the whole party. (Fire, all)
S530.name: Flare

S531.desc: The bear rears and squeezes. Your ribs creak. (Slowed)
S531.name: Crushing Hug

S532.desc: A crow-warrior's sword, too fast to see. Black feathers in the air after. (Katana)
S532.name: Feather Blade

S533.desc: A howl from somewhere that isn't the mountain. (all; Terror)
S533.name: Moon Howl

S534.desc: A handful of hot ash, flung in your eyes. (Blind)
S534.name: Choking Ash

S535.desc: A whip of the Bloodspeaker's own blood. (Taint chance)
S535.name: Blood Lash

S536.desc: "My blood is a key. Every lock opens." Maho paid in the caster's own blood. (all; Taint chance; costs it 4% of its HP)
S536.name: My Blood Is a Key

S537.desc: Haku's palm, a coal from the Furnace pressed into it. (Fire, one enemy)
S537.name: Ember Palm

S538.desc: Haku's Tamori ward over the party: Fire damage halved for three turns.
S538.name: Heat-Ward

S541.desc: School technique. Coin in an open hand. A person-for-hire takes it and goes home; anyone else loses their next move counting it. (Costs zeni)
S541.name: Barter Coin: Bribe

S542.desc: An Ide emissary's voice: reasonable, warm, impossible to fight against. (ATK down, all enemies)
S542.name: Words of Peace

S543.desc: A Unicorn tale of the ki-rin who carried Shinjo home. The party heals a little each turn. (Regen, all allies)
S543.name: Song of the Ki-Rin

S544.desc: Tamotsu's rice cakes, handed round the whole party whether they're hungry or not. (Heal all allies)
S544.name: Share the Stores

S545.desc: Iuchi Hiroichi's gaijin telescope, turned on the enemy line: every enemy's weaknesses.
S545.name: Gaijin Spyglass

S546.desc: Ryuko plants herself in front of the emissary: every enemy blow comes to her for two turns.
S546.name: Guardian's Vow

S547.desc: A Unicorn horsewoman's cut, swung wide from the saddle she isn't in. (Katana, all enemies)
S547.name: Shinjo Sweep

S548.desc: Gaijin pepper in a clay pot. "Burn, then! Burn like Motobu burned!" (Fire, all; sets off any powder keg)
S548.name: Powder Bomb

S549.desc: Naohida's gaijin broadsword, two-handed, all his hatred in it.
S549.name: Dai Dao Cleave

S559.desc: Karasu's glowing eyes, and a palmful of jade driven into the foe. "I learned this one from a very angry oni." (Jade, one enemy)
S559.name: Iuchi Karasu: Jade Strike

S555.desc: The servants' song, all in the same breath. Whoever hears it falls silent and starts to sway. (Silence, unless your ears are covered)
S555.name: Hum

S556.desc: Fingers in your ear, scrabbling for the wax. (Your ears are uncovered for the rest of the battle)
S556.name: Pull the Wax

S557.desc: "Stay! Stay with us! The dark is quiet!" A miner's pick three hundred years old.
S557.name: Stay With Us

S558.desc: The lanterns gutter and the dead lean in. (all; Terror chance)
S558.name: The Quiet Dark

S565.desc: Naohida runs at the enemy line with a lit keg. "Burn, then - just not them!" (Fire, all enemies)
S565.name: Naohida: Powder Charge

S566.desc: Rank 3. Tamotsu sees the next blow coming and moves first: the party is Veiled for three turns - no Wail or song can take them - and guards. (Once a battle)
S566.name: When the Veil Moves

S564.desc: "Himeko. The war is over, Himeko." Whoever hears it falls silent. (Silence, unless your ears are covered)
S564.name: Chant

S569.desc: A wind made of every apology nobody ever made. (all; maho, Taint chance)
S569.name: Every Apology

S571.desc: Kurosho's innate prayer: a staff of water hard as oak.
S571.name: Bo of Water

S572.desc: A lightning bolt from an old man's fingers. (all)
S572.name: Fury of Osano-Wo

S573.desc: A strong draught: a big heal for one ally.
S573.name: Ginseng + Rice Wine

S574.desc: Ginseng smoke over everyone: heals the whole party.
S574.name: Ginseng + Moxa

S575.desc: A purge: cures poison, blindness and silence, and heals a little.

S576.name: Rhubarb + Moxa

S577.desc: A festival burst thrown into one face. (Fire, one enemy)
S577.name: Hanabi + Rice Wine

S578.desc: The festival burst, spread wide. (Fire, all enemies)
S578.name: Hanabi + Moxa

S579.name: Ginseng + Willow Bark

S581.desc: Etiquette, of a sort. Something vain loses its next turn preening.

S583.desc: A bandage and a bitter leaf: heal one ally.
S583.name: Field Dressing

S584.desc: A paste no one should eat, flicked into a wound. (one enemy; Poison chance, E.Def down)
S584.name: Bitter Root

S589.desc: Two claws and a bite, one after another.
S589.name: Claw Combo

S585.desc: "RUN, wave-girl! Run like the eta run!" (all; Terror chance)
S585.name: Roar

S590.name: Feather Blade

S591.name: Wing Baffle

S592.desc: A bamboo spear, thrown before the biting starts.
S592.name: Spear Throw

S593.desc: "Be gone, you fat, rice-eating fools!" A walking stick, swung from the dark.
S593.name: "Be Gone!"

S513.name: Give Us Your Face

S514.desc: The python coils round you and squeezes. (Grapple: Speed down)
S514.name: Constrict

S515.desc: A sting as long as a finger. (Poison)
S515.name: Sting

S516.desc: A Crane magistrate's draw, still perfect, in a cultist's hands.
S516.name: Doji Iaijutsu

S517.desc: The abbot's open palm. There's nothing behind it either.

S512.desc: Maho from the iron box: every heart stumbles at once. (all; ATK down chance)
S512.name: Harvest of Death

S499.name: Feed the Ward-fire

S469.desc: She looks at you, and something in you cracks. (Void, all)
S469.name: Black-glass Void

S457.desc: A storm that makes no sound, all at once. (all; Air)
S457.name: Howling Silence

S450.desc: A Matsu champion's whole weight behind one cut.
S450.name: Matsu's Fury

S455.desc: Arrows out of the mist from the far bank. (all; ATK down)
S455.name: Arrows Across the River

S456.desc: Burning planks and sparks across the shield-line. (all; Fire)
S456.name: Flames on the Ford

S440.name: Coward's Whisper

S438.desc: Cold fingers on the back of the neck. (Terror)
S438.name: Dread Touch

S436.desc: The red shadow crawls over you and drinks. (Drains SP and VP: soul damage)
S436.name: Breath-eater

S473.desc: "Your Void tastes like mine. We're made of the same night." (drains SP and 1 VP)
S473.name: Void Drain

S441.name: Kitsu Jade-priest: Jade Prayer

S487.name: Old Diver: Diver's Harpoon

S488.desc: Rejuvenating tea for everyone, poured slowly. (Heal all allies)
S488.name: Shrine-keeper: Shrine Tea

S494.desc: A Crane ashigaru's yari, straight at the foreigners. (Yari, one enemy)
S494.name: Crane Ashigaru: Ashigaru Thrust

S495.desc: A blessing, mostly aimed. (Heal all allies)
S495.name: Isawa Novice: Novice's Blessing

S500.desc: Three arrows from a Centipede bow, into the gaijin line. (Yumi, all enemies)
S500.name: Centipede Scout: Centipede Volley

S501.desc: Bandages and a court song. (Heal all allies)
S501.name: Crane Field Medic: Field Dressing

S502.desc: Smoke and a falling backdrop: the old stage trick. (Blind chance, all enemies)
S502.name: Shosuro Stagehand: Smoke and Mirrors

S503.desc: A Suzume samurai sweeps courtyards for noble poverty, and enemies for you. (Bo, one enemy)
S503.name: Suzume Sweeper: Swept Clean

S504.desc: Fox herbs in hot water, and a song to the kami of the woods. (Heal all allies)
S504.name: Kitsune Herb-woman: Fox Herbs

S521.desc: A Shinjo horse-archer's volley from the back row. (Yumi, all enemies)
S521.name: Shinjo Yoriki: Horse-bow Volley

S528.desc: A Mirumoto ashigaru's yari, between you and the enemy. (Yari, one enemy)
S528.name: Mirumoto Ashigaru: Picket Thrust

S554.desc: Bitter roots from a refugee midwife. (Heal all allies)
S554.name: Refugee Herbalist: Midwife's Roots
S554.rt_hhome: the refugee camp at Buried Leaves

S586.desc: Festival rockets into the enemy line. Legal ones. (Fire, all enemies)
S586.name: Hanabi Seller: Hanabi Volley

S587.desc: A ferry archer's arrow, aimed at anything with feathers. (Yumi, one enemy)
S587.name: Mantis Ferry Archer: Ferry Shot

S594.name: Ginseng + Willow + Snow-Lotus

S595.desc: A slow brew: heals one ally, and keeps on healing (Regen).
S595.name: Ginseng + Snow-Lotus

S596.desc: Two fingers to a pressure point, and the blood forgets to move. (one enemy; Paralysis, never misses)
S596.name: Jinnai: Freezing the Lifeblood

S598.desc: Three retainers, three spear-points, one direction.
S598.name: Yari Line

S599.desc: A katana with the edge painted black. (Poison chance)
S599.name: Serpent's Cut

S600.desc: A Sparrow ronin's old blade, between the laces. (Katana, one enemy)
S600.name: Sparrow Ronin: Between the Laces

S602.desc: Two swords move like a hurricane: one cut, and then up to three more. (Katana, one enemy, 2-4 hits)
S602.name: Mirumoto Hikaru: Endless Strike

S633.desc: Kage's father's jade tanto, into the place a Hiruma always find. (Tanto and Jade, one enemy)
S633.name: Hiruma Kage: Father's Tanto

S635.desc: Rensei, with awe, exactly as rehearsed: "...Empress." Her guard drops. (Breaks her; half her shields if the play was handed over)
S635.name: "Empress" Bait

S636.desc: Mamoru's word: two travelers speak to her at once. She can't answer both. (She loses her next action)
S636.name: Two Voices

S637.desc: Sayo holds out a grey pebble. The Empress can't see colour: a jewel, surely. (She loses her next action)
S637.name: Smooth Stone Decoy

S638.desc: "I won't strike you. And so you won't strike me." (Rank 5: she's locked for her next action)
S638.name: The Immovable Hand of Peace

S605.desc: The bloodstones beat like a heart. Everyone in the hall feels it in their teeth. (all)
S605.name: Red Pulse

S606.desc: A blade three hundred years cold. (Speed down chance)
S606.name: Frozen Cut

S607.desc: Hanae stops being careful. One cut, all of her in it. (Katana, one enemy)
S607.name: Matsu Fury

S608.desc: The Matsu charge: straight through the enemy line. (Katana, all enemies)
S608.name: Lion's Charge

S603.desc: A goat-herd's hunting arrow, aimed for the soft place under the fur. (Yumi, one enemy)
S603.name: Goat-herd Archer: Bear Arrow

S604.desc: Handfuls of jade dust thrown over the enemy line. Things that should be dead hate it. (Jade, all enemies)
S604.name: Jade-dust Pedlar: Jade Dust

S609.desc: Anatomy (Ume-baa's low knowledge): hands on the body, not across the room. Heals one ally a little; the next Remedy on them is one tier stronger.
S609.name: Diagnosis

S615.desc: The ember charm spits one coal. Once a battle (shared with Rekindle). (Fire, one enemy)
S615.name: Ember: Spark

S616.desc: The ember charm breathes on someone who has gone cold. Once a battle (shared with Spark). (Revive one ally, a quarter of their HP)
S616.name: Ember: Rekindle

S610.desc: The spear-point glows like a pearl under deep water, and goes in very deep. (Yari, Water)
S610.name: Pearl Spear

S611.desc: The great serpent body sweeps round the whole stair and tightens. (all; Speed down chance)
S611.name: Coil

S612.desc: A needle from a pilgrim's sleeve, wet at the tip. (Poison chance)
S612.name: Poison Needle

S619.desc: A goblin soaked in lamp oil, alight and laughing, jumps on you. (Fire)
S619.name: Burning Leap

S620.desc: The ram the ogres carry, swung at whoever stands in the gate.
S620.name: Battering Ram

S621.desc: It says the name it stole, and it is pleased with itself. (all; Fear chance)
S621.name: A Good Man's Name

S622.desc: Grey silk out of the dark, over everyone. (all; Netted chance: loses its next action)
S622.name: Web of the Mori

S623.desc: Fangs wet with something from the Festering Pit. (Taint chance)
S623.name: Black Fang

S624.desc: Grey silk, round and round, until one of you is a parcel. (Netted chance: loses its next action)
S624.name: Cocoon

S625.desc: The Lava Tree shakes its branches, and it rains fire on everyone. (Fire, all)
S625.name: Ember Rain

S626.desc: She turns her loveliest face on one of you, and for a moment you'd do anything she asked. (Confuse chance)
S626.name: Look at Me

S627.desc: She rises on wings of smoke and comes down on all of you. (Air, all)
S627.name: Wings of Smoke

S628.desc: Each of you sees, for a moment, your own death: old and alone in the dark. (all; Fear chance)
S628.name: How You End

S629.desc: A hand of starless dark closes on one of you.
S629.name: The Long Night

S630.desc: The wound in her throat pulses, and black blood rains on everyone. (all; Taint chance)
S630.name: Fu Leng's Blood

S631.desc: Nails like a court of knives. (heavy, one)
S631.name: The Empress's Claw

S632.desc: She speaks in the voice of every soul she drank. (all; Fear chance)
S632.name: A Court of the Dead

S639.desc: Her father's rage, all of it, in one roar. (all; Fear chance)
S639.name: Akuma's Rage

S640.desc: She speaks a Jade Champion's name, and it cuts. (heavy, one)
S640.name: The Stolen Name

S641.desc: The Hiruma dead in the walls cry out, and the Taint comes with them. (all; Taint chance)
S641.name: The Castle Remembers

S642.desc: The tail comes over the rail like the sea itself. (Water, all)
S642.name: Tidal Lash

S643.desc: A coil of green scale as thick as a mast closes on one of you. (heavy, one)
S643.name: Coil

S644.desc: The souls of every ship it ever sank rise in the spray and look at you. (all; Fear chance)
S644.name: The Drowned Crews

S617.desc: An Osano-Wo monk claps his hands, and it thunders. (Air, all enemies)
S617.name: Osano-Wo Thunder Monk: Thunderclap

S567.name: Iuchi Water-Shugenja: Iuchi Tide

S568.desc: A Mirumoto sergeant's yari, from the second rank. (Yari, one enemy)
S568.name: Mirumoto Yari Sergeant: Sergeant's Thrust

S560.desc: A Togashi monk's Bo: it wakes a sleeper and drops a corpse. (Bo, one enemy)
S560.name: Togashi Bo-Monk: Waking Blow

S561.desc: An Agasha fire-prayer across the enemy line. (Fire, all enemies)
S561.name: Agasha Fire-Shugenja: Agasha Flame

S551.desc: Master of the Rolling River: a wave out of nowhere over every enemy. Wet powder won't burn. (Water, all enemies)
S551.name: Iuchi Water-Shugenja: Rolling River
S551.rt_hhome: the relief squads in the camps

S552.desc: A Moto rider's volley from the saddle, at a gallop. (Yumi, all enemies)
S552.name: Moto Outrider: Saddle Volley

S539.name: Tamori Rain-caller: Cooling Rain

S540.desc: Two blades, one breath: a Mirumoto guide's daisho. (Katana, one enemy, twice)
S540.name: Mirumoto Mountain Guide: Two Swords

S522.desc: A cut from the dark, and soot in the eyes. (Tanto, one enemy; Blind chance)
S522.name: Shadow Hunter: Hunter's Cut

S474.name: Sea-shrine Priestess: Storm Prayer

S475.name: Shiba Staff-sentry: Gate Staff

S466.name: Temple Bo-monk: Temple Staff

S458.name: Isawa Fire-acolyte: Acolyte's Flame

S459.desc: An oak staff across the knees. (Bo, one enemy)
S459.name: Shiba Staff-guard: Staff Sweep
